sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Metal Birds is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello again! Modern warfare is a really high-tech enterprise. My men have spotted drones operating in Tarkov. They were shot down, but we were unable to recover them. Search the Woods for them. If you find the controller or any other components, bring them to me. You will be well compensated."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate and obtain the motor controller on Woods
- Hand over the found item
- Locate and obtain the single-axis fiber optic gyroscope on Woods
- Hand over the found item

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- 3,000 EXP
- Peacekeeper Rep +0.1
- 550 Dollars
  - 578 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 633 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Wonderful, you found everything! Thank you for your work. Here is your share of the payment."

In this quest you have to pick up a motor controller and a single-axis fiber optic gyroscope on Woods.

The motor controller can be found on the center console of a black SUV at the USEC checkpoint west of the sawmill.

The single-axis fiber optic gyroscope can be found in an open weapon box located in the back of a blue pickup at the sawmill.
